requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C1 - case this request is about
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C1 - case this request is about
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court, docket number and disposition date, copied from your certificate of disposition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C2 - recorded outcome of the case
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C2 - recorded outcome of the case
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the outcome is the fact that decides whether this route applies, and it belongs to the participant's own record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the case ended, in the words your certificate of disposition uses

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C3 - what the criminal-history result showed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C3 - what the criminal-history result showed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: only the participant holds their own criminal-history result
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what the criminal-history result showed and the date you obtained it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C4 - what is being asked of the court
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C4 - what is being asked of the court
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform never writes a participant's own request for them
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what you are asking the court to transmit or correct, in your own words

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the person named in the caption, on the request
protectedBlanks.why: the participant signs personally; this build never signs for anyone

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the request
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the document is signed would be false
